2026-11-10 18:36:35.823324 | controller | template units). This means they are not meant to be enabled or disabled using systemctl.
2026-11-10 18:36:35.823328 | controller |
2026-11-10 18:36:35.823331 | controller | Possible reasons for having these kinds of units are:
2026-11-10 18:36:35.823335 | controller | • A unit may be statically enabled by being symlinked from another unit's
2026-11-10 18:36:35.823338 | controller |   .wants/, .requires/, or .upholds/ directory.
2026-11-10 18:36:35.823342 | controller | • A unit's purpose may be to act as a helper for some other unit which has
2026-11-10 18:36:35.823345 | controller |   a requirement dependency on it.
2026-11-10 18:36:35.823349 | controller | • A unit may be started when needed via activation (socket, path, timer,
